严重实现缺陷上游未复核
F1 · Registry PDF 预览用 blob+iframe，触发顶层导航 about:blank 并丢失登录态

NocoBase3 插件 · @nocobase/app-plugin-file · 原评审：未解决

⌄

file-preview-dialog.tsx 第 184–211 行在 kind==='pdf' 时 fetch contentUrl 生成 blob URL，再由 file-preview-content.tsx 第 80–83 行放进 <iframe src={url}>。该写法在 Chrome 下会劫持顶层页面导航，导致当前标签页变成 about:blank，随后访问业务路由被重定向到 /main/login。第 3、4、5 轮 QA 连续复现同一现象。

实际影响
任务明确要求 PDF 在应用内预览；默认 Registry 路径直接不可用，且会破坏整个会话，属于最严重的框架级附件缺陷。
建议改法
Registry 默认 PDF 预览改用 pdfjs-dist 渲染到 canvas（或使用不会改变顶层导航的嵌入方式），不要用 fetch+blob+iframe；同时在 SKILL 增加 PDF 的会话保持自检项。
诊断 · 触发条件、应有行为、绕行代价与验收标准
触发条件
在附件预览中打开或翻页到 PDF。
应有能力 / 行为
应用内展示 PDF 内容并保持当前页面与会话。
实际观察
当前标签页跳转 about:blank，随后被重定向 /main/login，登录态失效。
应用绕行与代价
App 复制 Registry 源码到 client/extensions/nocobase-file-component-ui，改用 pdfjs-dist 把页面渲染到 canvas，不再把 PDF 放进 iframe 的 blob URL。
改进后的验收标准
Registry 默认 PDF 路径在 Chrome 打开不改变顶层 URL、不丢会话；预览集成测试包含 PDF 的会话保持断言。
评审时证据 · 冻结快照 7 条
packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-file/registry/component-ui/components/file-preview-dialog.tsx:183–212E1

PDF 预览在 effect 中 fetch contentUrl 生成 blob URL（第 196 行 URL.createObjectURL），再作为 url 传给预览内容。

  // The content route downloads PDFs as attachments; a local blob can be embedded.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!sourceUrl || kind !== 'pdf') return undefined;
    const controller = new AbortController();
    let objectUrl: string | undefined;
    void fetch(sourceUrl, {
      credentials: fileUrlCredentials(sourceUrl),
      signal: controller.signal,
    })
      .then(async (response) => {
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Unable to load the PDF preview.');
        const blob = await response.blob();
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        objectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        setBlobUrl(objectUrl);
      })
      .catch((cause: unknown) => {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted)
          setError(
            cause instanceof Error
              ? cause.message
              : 'Unable to load the PDF preview.',
          );
      });
    return () => {
      controller.abort();
      if (objectUrl) URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl);
    };
  }, [sourceUrl, kind]);
  const url = kind === 'pdf' ? blobUrl : sourceUrl;

### [严重][实现缺陷] Registry PDF 预览用 blob+iframe，触发顶层导航 about:blank 并丢失登录态

**相关对象**：`@nocobase/app-plugin-file`（评审时 0.1.0-beta.15）

file-preview-dialog.tsx 第 184–211 行在 kind==='pdf' 时 fetch contentUrl 生成 blob URL，再由 file-preview-content.tsx 第 80–83 行放进 <iframe src={url}>。该写法在 Chrome 下会劫持顶层页面导航，导致当前标签页变成 about:blank，随后访问业务路由被重定向到 /main/login。第 3、4、5 轮 QA 连续复现同一现象。

**影响**：任务明确要求 PDF 在应用内预览；默认 Registry 路径直接不可用，且会破坏整个会话，属于最严重的框架级附件缺陷。

**建议改动**：Registry 默认 PDF 预览改用 pdfjs-dist 渲染到 canvas（或使用不会改变顶层导航的嵌入方式），不要用 fetch+blob+iframe；同时在 SKILL 增加 PDF 的会话保持自检项。

**验收标准**：Registry 默认 PDF 路径在 Chrome 打开不改变顶层 URL、不丢会话；预览集成测试包含 PDF 的会话保持断言。

**评审时证据（冻结快照）**：
- `packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-file/registry/component-ui/components/file-preview-dialog.tsx:183–212` — PDF 预览在 effect 中 fetch contentUrl 生成 blob URL（第 196 行 URL.createObjectURL），再作为 url 传给预览内容。
- `packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-file/registry/component-ui/components/previewers/file-preview-content.tsx:80–83` — case 'pdf' 直接把 url 放进 <iframe title={file.filename} src={url}>，即 blob URL 成为 iframe 内容。
- `artifacts/verify-3/browser-focused/report.json:63–63` — 第 3 轮 QA 记录：PDF 预览点击/翻页后当前标签页跳转 about:blank，随后访问工单被重定向 /main/login，登录态失效。
- `artifacts/verify-4/browser-focused/report.json:15–15` — 第 4 轮 QA 记录：PDF 预览跳 about:blank 并导致登出；同轮 B07 通过，观察员不可见内部字段且无权限用户打不开工单。
- `artifacts/verify-5/browser-focused/report.json:20–20` — 第 5 轮 QA 记录：PDF 直接点击或经 Next file 进入都跳 about:blank 并清空页面，随后被重定向登录，属真实业务失败。
- `artifacts/verify-6/browser-focused/report.json:13–13` — 第 6 轮 QA 记录：五种格式均渲染真实内容（PDF 为 canvas 文本），上传校验对损坏/不支持格式给出真实失败提示，下载字节哈希与夹具一致。
- `artifacts/agent-history/agent-repair-4.jsonl/part-0001.txt:234–237` — 第 4 轮修复调用中 Agent 明确识别缺陷为“PDF 预览导致 about:blank 并登出”，随后改为 canvas 渲染。

重要指引错误上游未复核
F2 · file SKILL 把“PDF via a fetched blob”写成推荐实现，且验证清单遗漏 PDF

文档 / Skill / 示例 · packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-file/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-file/SKILL.md · 原评审：未解决

⌄

SKILL 第 233 行明确写“Preview supports ... PDF via a fetched blob”，与 Registry 中引发缺陷的实现一致；第 245 行的预览集成验证清单只要求验证 DOCX/XLSX/PPTX 与请求生命周期，完全没有要求验证 PDF。

评审时 · 文档 / API 声称

skill 第 233 行称 PDF 通过 fetched blob 提供受支持预览。

评审时 · 实际观察

该 blob+iframe 路径正是第 3–5 轮 about:blank+掉登录态的根因，skill 未提示任何风险。

实际影响
Agent 会照着 skill 复现已损坏的 PDF 实现，并且自检时不会覆盖 PDF，导致缺陷跨越 3 个验证轮次。
建议改法
修正 skill 的 PDF 描述为 canvas/安全嵌入方案，并在验证清单与示例中加入 PDF 的会话保持与 about:blank 回归检查。
诊断 · 触发条件、应有行为、绕行代价与验收标准
触发条件
Agent 依据 skill 实现或验证 PDF 预览。
应有能力 / 行为
skill 描述安全可用的 PDF 预览方式，并要求验证会话不被破坏。
实际观察
skill 推荐 fetched blob，验证清单又漏掉 PDF。
应用绕行与代价
Agent 在修复轮自行改用 pdfjs canvas，skill 未提供该指引。
改进后的验收标准
skill 不再推荐 blob+iframe，验证清单包含 PDF 会话保持项。
评审时证据 · 冻结快照 4 条
packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-file/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-file/SKILL.md:233–233E3

SKILL 明确把“PDF via a fetched blob”列为受支持的预览实现。

Preview supports safe raster images, PDF via a fetched blob, text/Markdown and audio/video. HTML/SVG/XML previews and unsafe URL schemes are rejected. DOCX, XLSX and PPTX use lazily loaded `@silurus/ooxml` viewers to render locally from `FileRecord.contentUrl`; their content is not sent to a third-party preview service. Legacy DOC/XLS/PPT and OpenDocument formats use Office Online, which requires an internet-accessible absolute URL and cannot use the App session.
packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-file/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-file/SKILL.md:245–245E4

预览集成验证清单只点名 DOCX/XLSX/PPTX 与请求生命周期，未要求验证 PDF。

For preview integration or changes, verify each of DOCX/XLSX/PPTX with real files in development and a served production build. Check relative same-origin URLs, an authorized and unauthorized session, cross-origin CORS success/failure, failed requests and invalid documents, and `download={false}`. Close or switch files while loading and after a failure: pending requests must abort, viewers must be destroyed, and the next file must render without stale state. Unit mocks and a successful build do not establish document rendering fidelity.

实现者过程与运行背景 · 8 个过程问题 / 8 条建议 · 不自动归为框架问题

本任务已处理只描述应用侧处理结果，不代表 NocoBase3 上游已修复。

本轮过程记录

Repaired the equipment after-sales service and inspection application. Duplicate equipment codes now return a 409 business conflict instead of a raw SQLite unique-index error, and customer/equipment/ticket selects render names rather than raw ids. The ticket workflow captures handling hours in the completion dialog, return puts a ticket back in progress instead of the assignment queue, system-generated records no longer store untranslated English content, and manual ticket submission records a visible intake trace (register, route, notify). Notification titles are stored as translation keys and rendered in the recipient's language, and messages can be deleted. Ticket attachments are no longer enumerable by a user without access to the ticket, uploads are validated by extension and magic bytes, and attachment content URLs carry the application base path so preview and download work. A second verification round fixed four observed business defects: PDF and XLSX attachment previews (an octet-stream PDF Blob was retyped for the browser viewer, and a valid workbook missing the optional xl/styles.xml part is normalized before the OOXML viewer), an authorization leak that let a read-only observer read handling hours and the closure summary and call the return action, the messages inbox now refetching on reconnect, and server business errors rendered in the request's language (Chinese) instead of English. A third verification round addressed two more observed defects: the PDF attachment preview could navigate the tab to about:blank (the PDF branch began validating %PDF- magic bytes and retyping the Blob), and the XLSX viewer's hardcoded English zoom and tab controls are now localized to the interface language. The PDF fix was insufficient: the running build already contained it and the tab still left the application. A fourth round removed the browser's PDF viewer from the flow entirely. Because that viewer, handed a blob: document in a frame, could claim the top-level navigation and leave the tab on about:blank, the preview now validates the %PDF- magic bytes and renders the pages itself onto canvases with pdf.js, so the document never leaves the dialog.

问题 01 · verification

Cookie-authenticated API writes fail with INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN in standards test harness

本任务已处理

POST requests authenticated by a session cookie (for example POST /api/service/tickets/:id/submit and POST /api/service/integrations/keys) returned 403 {"code":"INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN"} while the same GET requests and the Better Auth sign-in POST succeeded.

原因（实现者自述）
auth.required() calls checkCookieWriteOrigin(), which rejects a cookie-bearing write unless its Origin/Referer is a Better Auth trusted origin. Those origins derive from the authentication provider's baseURL, which it reads from the app config value app.publicOrigin. In the test harness that value was never set, so the trusted-origin set was empty. The tests had also passed a publicOrigin option to createInstalledStandaloneServer, but that option is not part of StandaloneServerOptions and was silently ignored.
处理方式
Set env APP_PUBLIC_ORIGIN (the documented env of server/config/app.ts publicOrigin) on the installed test server and send a matching Origin: http://localhost header on every cookie-authenticated write in tests/logic/app-server.test.ts. All four service operations API tests then pass.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 02 · verification

PDF attachment stored as application/octet-stream previews as an empty frame

本任务已处理

Opening a PDF attachment whose upload carried no media type (stored and served as application/octet-stream) showed an empty preview frame instead of the document, while a PDF stored as application/pdf previewed normally in the same ticket.

原因（实现者自述）
The client fetched the content URL into a Blob and kept the response Content-Type (application/octet-stream), then passed that Blob to URL.createObjectURL. The browser built-in PDF viewer renders only a blob whose type is application/pdf, so it produced a blank frame. The attachment content route echoes the stored media type, and an upload without a media type is stored as application/octet-stream.
处理方式
The file-component extension PDF preview branch now retypes the fetched Blob to application/pdf before creating the object URL unless it is already application/pdf (client/extensions/nocobase-file-component-ui/components/file-preview-dialog.tsx). Verified with Playwright against a rebuilt app: the octet-stream PDF now yields a blob: iframe whose document Chrome renders, and a component test asserts the created Blob type is application/pdf.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 03 · verification

XLSX preview refuses a valid workbook that omits the optional xl/styles.xml part

本任务已处理

A minimal xlsx fixture (a valid OOXML workbook that Excel opens) failed with 'Unable to render this Office Open XML file.', while a workbook written by a full generator previewed normally.

原因（实现者自述）
@silurus/ooxml's XlsxViewer requires the xl/styles.xml part. ECMA-376 leaves that part optional, so a hand-built workbook that omits it is refused even though its content is intact. Reproduced by generating a minimal xlsx with only the required parts (it failed) and by adding an xl/styles.xml that was neither declared in [Content_Types].xml nor referenced from the workbook relationships (it rendered), proving the part's mere presence is the gate rather than its content or declarations.
处理方式
The OOXML preview now checks for xl/styles.xml with a filtered unzip before handing an xlsx to the viewer and, only when the part is absent, adds a minimal styles part and re-zips the archive (fflate added as a client devDependency); a workbook that already has the part is passed through byte-for-byte. Verified with Playwright against a rebuilt app: the previously failing fixture now renders a canvas with no error, and component tests cover both the injected and the pass-through case.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 04 · verification

Read-only observer could read internal handling fields and invoke the return action

本任务已处理

A service observer (no viewInternal, no return capability) saw 'Hours spent' and the closure/handling summary on a ticket, received the handling summary from GET /tickets/:id/records, and a direct POST /tickets/:id/return answered 200.

原因（实现者自述）
listRecords only nulled content for a record kind 'internal', a kind no transition writes; the handling summary and hours are stored on the 'handle' record and were returned unchanged. toTicketView exposed closeSummary unconditionally, and returnTicket performed no capability check, so the state change relied only on the UI hiding it.
处理方式
listRecords now resolves canViewInternal once and hides content for the handle/internal record kinds and nulls hours for a reader without viewInternal, so both the ticket view and the direct records route obey it; toTicketView hides closeSummary unless internalVisible; returnTicket begins with access.require(tickets, 'return'). A new app-server test asserts the observer receives null hours, null handling content and null closeSummary and a 403 when calling return.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 05 · verification

Messages inbox never refetches when the browser comes back online

本任务已处理

A message written while the browser was offline (or the tab was hidden) did not appear until a manual reload; the inbox never refetched on reconnect.

原因（实现者自述）
The inbox loaded once through useAsyncData and registered no listener for connection or visibility recovery, so nothing re-ran the fetch after the browser regained connectivity.
处理方式
client/pages/service/messages.tsx registers window 'online' and document 'visibilitychange' (when visible) listeners that reload the inbox, removing them on unmount and re-binding when the loader identity changes. Verified with Playwright against a rebuilt app: dispatching an online event produced a second GET /notifications/in-app.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 06 · verification

Server business errors stayed English in a Chinese interface

本任务已处理

Domain errors surfaced as English sentences inside a Chinese UI, for example '保存失败 The equipment code EQ-QA-B02-01 already exists.' and '附件上传失败。 Unsupported file type: .exe'.

原因（实现者自述）
Server error messages were plain English strings with no translation lookup; the client renders error.message directly, and the application server locale files existed but were empty, so even a correct lookup would have found no resource.
处理方式
DomainError now carries an optional key and params; server/routes/helpers.ts translates the key (defaulting to the English message) through getRequestTranslator with literal-key separators and uses it in the {error, code} body, and the integration content route uses the same serializer. server/locales/en-US.ts and zh-CN.ts map all 70 messages, with explicit key+params at the six sites that interpolate a value. Verified with a zh-CN request returning 设备编码 … 已存在。 beside the unchanged CONFLICT code, and an en-US request returning the English sentence.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 07 · verification

PDF attachment preview navigated the tab to about:blank instead of rendering

本任务已处理

In the ticket attachment preview, moving to the PDF file lost the ticket page: the tab ended at about:blank and the next visit to /main/service/tickets/:id redirected to /main/login. The other formats (PNG, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX) previewed in place, and upload/download and corrupt-file handling otherwise passed.

原因（实现者自述）
The client handed the document to Chrome's built-in PDF viewer as a blob: URL inside an iframe. In the acceptance engine that viewer, given a blob document in a frame, could take over the top-level navigation: the tab left the application for about:blank and the page was torn down, after which the in-memory session was gone and the next visit to /main/service/tickets/:id redirected to /main/login. The application log confirmed the content route answered 200 with the correct 593-byte PDF immediately before the navigation, so the fetch, the response headers and the stored media type were not at fault, and the earlier %PDF- byte-retyping fix was already present in the running build. A bare about:blank navigation does not by itself end the session (navigating a fresh session to about:blank and back preserved it), so the logout was a consequence of the tab or renderer teardown, not of the preview request. Sandboxing the iframe was rejected because this engine renders no PDF inside a sandboxed frame, which blanked the preview.
处理方式
The PDF preview no longer uses the browser plugin or a blob: URL. A new client/extensions/nocobase-file-component-ui/components/previewers/pdf-preview.tsx fetches the bytes with the same origin-aware credentials, validates them with the %PDF- magic-byte check (isPdfContent) before any viewer is created, then loads them with pdfjs-dist (imported dynamically; its worker is emitted by Vite as an asset and resolved through the runtime base path) and draws each page onto a canvas inside the dialog, capped at 30 pages with a localized notice (files.pdfPageLimit). PreviewBody in file-preview-dialog.tsx no longer creates an object URL, and FilePreviewContent's pdf branch no longer renders an iframe. pdfjs-dist 5.6.205 was added as a client devDependency. Verified against the rebuilt application with a fresh browser session signed in through the UI: clicking Preview: sample.pdf, and reaching sample.pdf through the preview dialog's Next file, kept the top URL on /main/service/tickets/6, created no iframe, fetched the emitted pdf.worker asset, rendered a canvas whose pixel analysis shows the document text, kept the session valid across a reload, and produced no console error; PNG, DOCX, XLSX and PPTX previews still render. Unit tests assert the canvas rendering, that no object URL or iframe is created, the non-PDF rejection, and the page-cap notice.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 08 · verification

XLSX preview controls stayed in English in a Chinese interface

本任务已处理

With the interface in Chinese, the XLSX viewer's zoom and tab-scroll buttons still exposed English accessible names and title tooltips (Zoom out, Zoom in, Zoom, Scroll tabs left, Scroll tabs right), and the spreadsheet region label stayed English.

原因（实现者自述）
@silurus/ooxml renders its spreadsheet chrome with hardcoded English strings and exposes no locale or labels option, so those strings never pass through the application's i18n; the file plugin's namespace does not translate them either.
处理方式
After the viewer loads, the preview localizes its DOM in place (client/extensions/nocobase-file-component-ui/lib/xlsx-localization.ts): it sets title and aria-label on the tab-nav buttons and the zoom slider group, and the region label, using useTranslation('@nocobase/app-plugin-file') so the wording resolves through the application fallback namespace, and watches the viewer with a MutationObserver so controls created later are localized too. Keys files.xlsxZoom / xlsxZoomIn / xlsxZoomOut / xlsxScrollTabsLeft / xlsxScrollTabsRight / xlsxViewport were added to client/locales/en-US.ts and zh-CN.ts. Verified in a rebuilt app in a Chinese session: the controls read 缩小, 缩放, 放大, 向左滚动工作表标签, 向右滚动工作表标签 and the Chinese region label in both aria-label and title, while the English session still shows English.

实现者补充建议

建议 01 · framework

Standalone test-harness publicOrigin option is silently ignored

可自动化

tests/logic/app-server.test.ts declares a publicOrigin option on its test server options and forwards it to createStandaloneServer, but the underlying StandaloneServerOptions/CreateStandaloneScopeOptions do not define publicOrigin, so it never reaches app config. The only working way to set the application public origin for an installed server is the APP_PUBLIC_ORIGIN environment override, which is non-obvious and makes cookie-write CSRF checks fail with a 403 that does not point at the missing origin.

建议改动

Either honour a publicOrigin option in the standalone server options, or have the test harness write app.publicOrigin into the runtime test config (or reject the unknown option) so a cookie-authenticated write test does not need to know about the APP_PUBLIC_ORIGIN indirection.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 02 · framework

In-app notification items have no locale, so a server-produced title cannot be translated at write time

可自动化

The in-app notification table stores a single title per recipient with no locale column, and the i18n plugin keeps the active locale only in the session. A notification produced by a server service therefore cannot be written in the recipient's language. The workaround stores the stable translation key (for example service.notifications.needsAssignment) as the title and translates it in the client at read time, which leaves any already-persisted human-readable title untranslated.

建议改动

Let a notification be produced from a translation key plus arguments and resolve it against the recipient's locale at read time (or store the recipient locale with the item), so services never have to encode the localization convention in their title strings.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 03 · framework

Base UI Select silently renders the raw value when Root has no items map

可自动化

The application's Select wraps @base-ui/react/select, whose Value renders the raw selected value unless Root receives an items prop that maps values to labels. A Select composed with only SelectItem children therefore shows an id or code instead of the label, with no warning at build or runtime. This is how customer and equipment filters displayed raw ids.

建议改动

Document the items requirement for Base UI Select in the UI workflow reference, or add a development warning when a Select has SelectItem children but no items map, so the missing labels surface before review.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 04 · template

File preview relies on the browser's built-in PDF viewer for attachments

可自动化

The file-component registry item previews a PDF by embedding the browser's PDF viewer in an iframe over a blob: URL. In the acceptance engine that viewer, given a blob document in a frame, could claim the top-level navigation and leave the application on about:blank, tearing down the page; the application has no way to detect or prevent it, and sandboxing the frame is not a fix because the engine renders no PDF inside a sandboxed frame. The shipped component also had no test that exercised a real PDF, so the failure was invisible until an upload.

建议改动

Render PDF pages without the browser plugin — for example by shipping a canvas-based viewer (pdf.js) as the default PDF preview — or at least document the plugin dependency and constrain the frame so a viewer failure cannot escape the page; add a fixture test that opens a real PDF.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 05 · framework

@silurus/ooxml rejects a workbook missing the optional xl/styles.xml part

可自动化

The XLSX viewer treats the styles part as required, while ECMA-376 marks it optional and the part is absent from many minimally generated workbooks that Excel opens. The failure is reported only as the generic "Unable to render this Office Open XML file.", so the missing part is not discoverable from the error.

建议改动

Have the viewer tolerate a missing styles part (or accept a default styles sheet), or include the missing part name and stage in the error so an application can repair the file. A conformance fixture without xl/styles.xml belongs in the package tests.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 06 · framework

Business domain errors have no built-in translation path

可自动化

Server services throw DomainError subclasses whose message is a user-visible English sentence. The route serializer emitted that message verbatim, and the application server locale files were empty templates, so a translated UI still showed English business errors and the only fix was to add key/params plumbing and hand-map every message.

建议改动

Give the domain-error base class an optional i18n key and arguments by default, translate in the shared response serializer, and ship the application server locale scaffolding with a documented convention (or a check that every thrown business message has a locale entry) so localization does not require each application to build the mechanism.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 07 · framework

Declared capabilities and endpoint guards can drift without a failing test

可自动化

A permission set declares actions such as tickets.return, but enforcement lives in a separate access.require call inside each service function; one transition (returnTicket) omitted it, so an observer could call the endpoint even though the role never had the capability. Nothing tied the declared capability list to the endpoints that should enforce it.

建议改动

Derive or test endpoint guards from the declared capability set, so adding a capability or a transition without its access.require fails a test instead of silently expanding access; a matrix test that calls each mutating route as a role lacking its capability and expects 403 would catch this class.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 08 · framework

Bundled XLSX viewer hardcodes English chrome with no localization option

可自动化

@silurus/ooxml's XlsxViewerOptions exposes imageResources, cellScale, resizable, showScrollbars, the zoom range and callbacks, but no locale, labels or messages option. Its zoom and tab-scroll controls and its spreadsheet region label are literal English strings, so an application cannot translate them through the shared i18n runtime and has to mutate the viewer's DOM after load.

建议改动

Add a labels/locale option (or accept translated strings) to XlsxViewerOptions so the chrome and the region label come from the application's translator instead of being hardcoded.

来源：Agent · retro.json

E1 · packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-file/registry/component-ui/components/file-preview-dialog.tsx:183–212

PDF 预览在 effect 中 fetch contentUrl 生成 blob URL（第 196 行 URL.createObjectURL），再作为 url 传给预览内容。

  // The content route downloads PDFs as attachments; a local blob can be embedded.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!sourceUrl || kind !== 'pdf') return undefined;
    const controller = new AbortController();
    let objectUrl: string | undefined;
    void fetch(sourceUrl, {
      credentials: fileUrlCredentials(sourceUrl),
      signal: controller.signal,
    })
      .then(async (response) => {
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Unable to load the PDF preview.');
        const blob = await response.blob();
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        objectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        setBlobUrl(objectUrl);
      })
      .catch((cause: unknown) => {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted)
          setError(
            cause instanceof Error
              ? cause.message
              : 'Unable to load the PDF preview.',
          );
      });
    return () => {
      controller.abort();
      if (objectUrl) URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl);
    };
  }, [sourceUrl, kind]);
  const url = kind === 'pdf' ? blobUrl : sourceUrl;

SKILL 明确把“PDF via a fetched blob”列为受支持的预览实现。

Preview supports safe raster images, PDF via a fetched blob, text/Markdown and audio/video. HTML/SVG/XML previews and unsafe URL schemes are rejected. DOCX, XLSX and PPTX use lazily loaded `@silurus/ooxml` viewers to render locally from `FileRecord.contentUrl`; their content is not sent to a third-party preview service. Legacy DOC/XLS/PPT and OpenDocument formats use Office Online, which requires an internet-accessible absolute URL and cannot use the App session.

Check relative same-origin URLs, an authorized and unauthorized session, cross-origin CORS success/failure, failed requests and invalid documents, and `download={false}`. Close or switch files while loading and after a failure: pending requests must abort, viewers must be destroyed, and the next file must render without stale state. Unit mocks and a successful build do not establish document rendering fidelity.

E6 · packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-file/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-file/SKILL.md:235–235

SKILL 说明 OOXML/PDF/text fetch 使用同源凭据，跨域省略凭据，Bearer token 不会自动附带。

OOXML, PDF and text fetches use same-origin credentials. An App-owned content route protected by same-origin session cookies can therefore serve restricted previews, provided it checks the caller's record access. Cross-origin fetches omit credentials and require CORS; an external cookie-protected URL is not supported by this default path. The Repository API client's Bearer token is not automatically attached to content fetches.

## Naming translation keys

Use short semantic keys that describe the purpose of the text and stay valid when its wording changes. Use lower camelCase within each segment and dots for useful feature or context groups, such as `files.uploadFailed` or `demo.pageDescription`. A small namespace may use `title` directly. Do not use complete English sentences as keys or merely convert a sentence into camelCase.

- Do not build a language picker. `useAppLocale()` exists; `app-template-default` already renders one in `client/shell/language-switcher.tsx`.
- Do not add i18n machinery to an application. The plugin is registered by default and the runtime is wired in `createAppRuntime`.
- Do not use `@nocobase/app-portal-sdk/i18n`. It is the retired Portal runtime with its own i18next instance; mixing the two leaves each holding half the resources.

E12 · packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-authorization/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-authorization/SKILL.md:56–58

SKILL 规定实现顺序：defineDatabasePermission、defineCompositeResource、collections.add/compositeResources.define/recordAccess.define，以及 authorizeRepository 或 authz.middleware。

2. Declare reusable collection permissions with `defineDatabasePermission`; compose user-facing business operations as composite resources with `defineCompositeResource` from `@nocobase/authorization/core`. Explicitly name fields, relation capabilities and every collection a workflow touches.
3. In the owning provider's `boot`, opt collections in with `authz.database.collections.add`, register composites with `authz.compositeResources.define`, record access with `authz.recordAccess.define` and settings items with `authz.settings.add`. Then add a workspace subsection with `authz.ui.sections.add({ name, title, parent })` and list each composite or settings item in it with `authz.ui.place(reference, { section, group? })` (the permission workspace lists sections and subsections on the left and the selected subsection's resources, under optional `authz.ui.groups`, on the right; an unplaced composite or settings item goes under its default section's Other with a startup warning, and a misplaced one fails a development start). Pages are not registered on the server: the client route tree lists them. Release subject registrations at shutdown.
4. Protect every server route with authentication. For a simple single-scope Repository operation, keep `defineRepositoryApiRoutes` and add `authz.database.authorizeRepository` to map methods to composite actions; it reuses or initializes the request's authorization context. For workflows, persisted-state checks, multiple data scopes or custom responses, install `authz.middleware()`, call `c.get('authz').authorize()` once and bind every returned collection policy with `repository.withPolicy()`. Follow [Repository route integration](references/repository-routes.md).

E13 · packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-authorization/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-authorization/SKILL.md:66–68

SKILL 明确未注册 collection 默认拒绝、catalog 与 record 类型差异，以及 can/require/authorize 的使用边界。

- `settings`, `composite` and `database.collection` are catalog types: a check on an unregistered item or action is denied with `RESOURCE_ACTION_NOT_SUPPORTED`. `page`, `user`, `notification` and Hub types are record types that declare actions only; their grants use `id: '*'` for every record.
- A composite action composes exactly the grants it lists, never another composite. A data scope targets the one collection its grant actions name, whose type must declare `recordAccess` (`database.collection` does). Grant page access separately; a page grant never authorizes a server endpoint.
- `can` is for feature visibility. `require` needs an unconditional permit and rejects conditional decisions. Business endpoints use `authorize`, reject denial or missing policies, and consume `conditions.database` without resolving collection grants again.

  3. 刷新后逐格式点击预览按钮并检查渲染出的真实内容：PNG 对话框内 <img> naturalWidth/Height=32x32，画布取中心像素为蓝色 [40,110,190]（对应 '蓝色正方形'）；PDF 渲染出 870x1125 canvas，非白像素 3331（真实文本排版）；DOCX 渲染节点 [data-office-open-xml-format=docx] 文本为 'Factory DOCX sample'；XLSX 渲染出 870x413 canvas，非白像素 37963，工作表标签为 'Sample'；PPTX 渲染节点 [data-office-open-xml-format=pptx] 文本为 'Factory PPTX sample'。以上均为实际内容渲染，而非仅显示文件名。
  4. 逐格式点击预览对话框内的 App 'Download' 按钮（浏览器下载目录已指向证据目录），下载产物与测试准备 manifest 的 sha256 完全一致：sample.png=eafcdecc1468f7b18a15a7d22c494ab7e14a435f0560798ad463efc5e14f3490、sample.pdf=6cb99aa93ea5607509fc676bf82e835728a7c44aa9f584a0974600765c0f8fc3、sample.docx=06408d7e3a01fd82bc32240dbd035d6366ac701f50c1a90f12eb49f47288cd6e、sample.xlsx=aebb2e45d35551150c56edd7bf7e09e46cc1423a6a99e3545c593c946f179b4e、sample.pptx=304a16d1c38e3b7fde3accdaff511811be3200227e314c6996c7e741fe8d71cc，证明刷新后可重新下载且内容无损。

完整原始验收要求
以下仅为业务浏览器验收。逐条记录实际操作、观察、证据；模块代码/Skill 检查见独立评审评论，不能用页面通过代替代码评审，也不能要求浏览器 QA 伪造源码证据。

B01. 以主管、华东工程师、华南工程师、协作工程师、观察员分别登录，验证各自入口及允许/禁止的业务操作；角色切换不保留前一账号的权限。
B02. 新增客户和设备、编辑后刷新，验证值回填与保存；重复设备编号、无效客户设备关联有清晰反馈。
B03. 搜索、区域/状态筛选、分页、详情刷新和返回列表正常，结果不能混入无权访问的记录。
B04. 按草稿、提交、分派、处理、待确认、退回、再次处理、关闭跑通一张工单；验证转派/取消原因和关闭后的限制。
B05. 快速重复提交/关闭同一工单不产生重复业务结果；不能跳过必要状态直接关闭。
B06. 实际上传 PNG、PDF、DOCX、XLSX、PPTX 小型合法文件并保存业务关联；逐格式检查显示的内容而非文件名，刷新后重新预览、下载；损坏或不支持的文件给出失败提示。文件测试样例由测试准备生成或提供，不能把浏览器 QA 自行生成文件当成浏览器操作。
B07. 用无工单访问权的普通用户尝试打开工单及其附件，不能显示内容；观察员看不到内部成本字段且不能编辑。
B08. 默认知识可读范围、指定工单跨区分享、分享撤销、保密限制分别生效；分享不能自动授予原本没有的操作。
B09. 分派后收件人消息中心出现对应持久消息，可跳转、已读/未读、删除；刷新/重新登录后状态正确，其他用户看不到；断开再恢复连接后可补齐消息。
B10. 保存成功、必填校验和一次真实失败都有正确的即时反馈，失败后未保存内容可恢复，不以 toast 冒充站内信。
B11. 从自动受理的执行记录查看步骤与实际工单结果；失败场景保留失败原因，恢复不删除旧记录或重复通知。
B12. 管理员查看巡检/超期计划，使用测试环境提供的短周期或受控触发观察实际执行；执行结束时业务结果一致，重复执行不重复创建当天巡检；停用后不再产生新任务。
B13. 看板数值与当前用户能看到的工单一致，状态变更和筛选后更新；不同岗位不出现越权统计。
B14. 管理员创建、停用、重新启用测试用户并维护岗位；停用后的原会话不可继续使用，其他业务账户不受影响。只读业务管理员可查看数据结构，但不能改表。
B15. 切换中英文，逐页检查导航、字段、弹窗、文件组件、消息及错误反馈；刷新/直接地址访问正常，不能只有中文静态页面。
B16. 服务助手未配置时准确提示且手工流程正常；配置测试模型的扩展轮次才验证真实问答、上下文范围、建议草稿、确认/拒绝和对话恢复。外部通知同理：没有测试服务标为扩展场景未执行，不声称实投成功。

API 密钥的 HTTP 调用、服务端越权/幂等、代码边界、安装引导和 Hub 发布属于独立集成/模块评审，不将它们冒充浏览器截图验收。测试角色账号可通过管理员 UI 创建，统一使用本轮测试密码配置；测试准备缺失、基础环境失败与真实业务缺陷分别报告。
